praneybehl-llm-wiki-plugin-llm-wiki.description: Build and maintain an LLM-curated knowledge base from papers, articles, transcripts, notes and project findings. Ingest sources into linked Markdown, answer questions with citations, lint or upgrade a wiki, and preserve useful synthesis across sessions and agents. Also capture verified task experience, consolidate success/failure patterns, and propose, evaluate, apply or roll back evidence-linked skill improvements. Trigger on "add this to my wiki", "what does the wiki say", "learn from this task", "improve this procedure", /wiki:learn or /wiki:evolve. Use index-first navigation, atomic pages…
